subject: Cloudbridge × Redwood — multi-region SI + marketplace demo coordination
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudbridge.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Co-sell technical demo: Cloudbridge + Redwood (marketplace + SI)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Cloudbridge is excited to move to a joint demo with Redwood where we show the end-to-end marketplace procurement flow (AWS Marketplace) + an SI-led integration scenario for our EU customers. High-level ask: a 60–75 minute technical demo + short commercial handoff. We have three objectives: 1) validate marketplace procurement + entitlements, 2) demonstrate Redwood private deployment in a VPC with our SI integration, 3) capture follow-up MAP tasks.

Ideal window: any day next week (25–28 May) between 09:00–13:00 BST. We have the Cloudbridge engineering lead (me), our partner ops contact, and a product manager joining.

Can you loop in Redwood partner/marketplace folks and SRE/SE who can speak to on-prem/VPC routing? Also, can you share a short runbook and mutual action plan draft we can iterate on?

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Amit Shah
Head of Partnerships | Cloudbridge Systems
attachments: none (will attach MAP when vendor-ready)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Co-sell technical demo: Cloudbridge + Redwood (marketplace + SI)

Amit — thanks for the clear scope. Looping in Vanessa (partner lead), Jonas (marketplace enablement), Marissa (SE for SI integrations) and Grace (CS) so we have the right coverage.

Quick notes / asks from Redwood side:
- Format: 15m intros, 40–50m walkthrough (marketplace purchase -> provisioning -> SI integration), 10–15m Q&A and next steps.
- We prefer 60 min to keep it focused; 75 min is OK if we have additional stakeholders.
- Proposed slots (BST):
  • Tue 25 May 10:00–11:00
  • Wed 26 May 09:30–10:30
  • Thu 27 May 11:00–12:00

Marissa — can you prepare a quick demo runbook showing the VPC onboarding flow and a fallback path (hosted API) in case of network constraints?
Vanessa / Jonas — can you confirm whether AWS marketplace procurement needs an existing entitlement mapping for EU customers (we may need marketplace-ops looped in).

Attaching an initial MAP draft and a runbook stub for your review. I’ll follow up with calendar invites once we agree on a slot.

Attachments: CB-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx; demo-runbook-draft.pdf

—
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +44 7700 900111
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:17:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Co-sell technical demo: Cloudbridge + Redwood (marketplace + SI)

Thanks — quick availability update from partners/marketplace side. Jonas and I synced with AWS marketplace ops; Leah (cc in the thread below) asked for a confirmed agenda and the list of AWS accounts that will demo procurement. If we include EU entitlements, AWS wants to verify account IDs ahead of time (they said 48-hour lead time).

From Redwood side, our recommended slot to maximize overlap across EU/APAC is Thu 27 May 10:00–11:00 BST (that hits 14:30–15:30 IST and 11:00–12:00 CET). If that works for Cloudbridge, we can:
- Confirm agenda now (I suggested Karthik’s outline).
- Provide the entitlement checklist to Amit — Jonas, please paste the checklist in this thread.
- Marissa: please include a short network diagram in the runbook PDF (VPC peering vs. private link vs. hosted fallback).

Amit — if you can share the prospective AWS account IDs and confirm Thu 27 May 10:00 BST, we’ll lock it and send invites. I’ll also attach a one-page marketplace checklist to the invite.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Go-to-Market, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0199
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudbridge.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.com, marketplace-ops@aws-partners.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Co-sell technical demo: Cloudbridge + Redwood (marketplace + SI)

Vanessa / Karthik — Thu 27 May 10:00 BST works for us. Confirmed attendees: Amit Shah (Cloudbridge), Ritu Menon (engineering lead, ritu.m@cloudbridge.com), Tom Ellis (product), and our procurement contact. AWS account IDs: 111222333444, 555666777888 (EU).

We reviewed the MAP and runbook — looks good. Two quick asks ahead of the session:
1) Can Redwood include a 5–7 minute slide on your Dedicated vs Private deployment SLOs (latency/throughput) so our procurement can annotate the contract?
2) Please add the entitlement checklist as an appendix to the calendar invite (Jonas / Leah: appreciate the 48-hour pull).

I’ve attached an updated MAP with task owners and added a short agenda. Also dropped a calendar stub (timezone-availability.ics) — feel free to overwrite with Redwood’s invite. If we’re all set, I’ll forward a DocuSign link for the non-binding PoC statement of work after the demo.

See you on Thu — appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Amit Shah
Head of Partnerships | Cloudbridge Systems
attachments: CB-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (updated), timezone-availability.ics
